content_en: In July 1897, Armenian fighters crossed into Persia and rode against the Mazrik tribe at Khanasor, answering the killing of Armenian volunteers the year before. The full account, with maps and the men who rode, is preserved here as one of the defining actions of the fedayi era — a rare moment when the movement answered force with force, planned and executed across a border, and became legend in the retelling long before it became history in the archive.
